name: Festival Stone of Warmtide
title: Festival Stone of Warmtide
summary: 'The Stone of Warmtide is part of the ruined Inner Sea port across the Yaraq Cove' (Alatar Locke). In the kit the stone and its glow stand on a hilltop (z 50) inside a shrine of four Empyrean monuments (two obelisks, a pillar and a small stone tower, 2.8-5.8 m), overlooking the Inner Sea Port Ruins and the cove 100 m south-east.

landmarks.name: Festival Stone of Warmtide
landmarks.note: Festival Stone spawn with the Anniversary glow.

site.name: Festival Stone of Warmtide
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer warmtide-festival-stone (hilltop, 12 m south-west of the stone).

shots.standingOrder: Orbit the glowing Warmtide stone and its four Empyrean obelisks 26 m out and 16 m above the hilltop, the Inner Sea cove and the port ruins wheeling below; keep 15 m from every obelisk, creatures may be faded.
shots.notes: Orbit of the Festival Stone of Warmtide on its hilltop shrine of four Empyrean obelisks, 50 m above the cove, with the Inner Sea, the drowned colonnade and Yaraq Cove wheeling below in golden light. shots.standingOrder: Pull back and up due west from 9 m to 55 m away from the glowing stone in one line until the hilltop shrine and the cove beyond open out; keep 5 m from the obelisks and the small stone tower, creatures may be faded.
